description: This file contains functions for resolving providers and their capabilities related to thinking policies in a plugin-based system. It includes functions to match provider IDs, find active providers, and resolve specific thinking levels or abilities based on provider configurations.

methods.name: function matchesProviderId(provider: ProviderPlugin, providerId: string): boolean { matchesProviderId
methods.description: Checks if a given provider matches a specified provider ID after normalization, considering aliases.

methods.name: function resolveActiveThinkingProvider(providerId: string): ProviderPlugin | undefined { resolveActiveThinkingProvider
methods.description: Finds and returns the active provider plugin matching a given provider ID.

methods.name: export function resolveProviderBinaryThinking( resolveProviderBinaryThinking
methods.description: Resolves whether the provider supports binary thinking.

methods.name: export function resolveProviderXHighThinking( resolveProviderXHighThinking
methods.description: Resolves whether the provider supports x-high thinking capabilities.

methods.name: export function resolveProviderDefaultThinkingLevel( resolveProviderDefaultThinkingLevel
methods.description: Resolves the default thinking level for a provider.
